1. (Currently amended) A system for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: a computing device including a processor coupled to a system memory, the system memory storing instructions for execution on the processor, the instructions configured to cause the processor to: retrieve a network data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain __from a plurality of heterogeneous data sources including at least one of network flow data, DNS query logs, or BGP routing tables__; analyze the network data __using machine learning algorithms trained on historical threat patterns__ and identify a malicious network threat; and perform a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat __by automatically executing one or more of: null routing, access control list modification, or network isolation without human intervention__.

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to push a notification including the mitigating action for the malicious network threat to a third party device __only after the mitigating action has been executed and verified to have successfully neutralized the threat__.
